description_en: Queries the endpoints of the virtual private clouds (VPCs) in which a Container Registry instance is deployed
kebab_example: aliyun cr get-instance-vpc-endpoint --instance-id cri-kmsiwlxxdcva0000 --module-name Chart --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetInstanceVpcEndpoint

parameters.help_en:
The name of the module that you want to access. Valid values:

`Registry`: the image repository.
`Chart`: a Helm chart
parameters.help_zh:
设置访问的模块，取值：

`Registry`：访问镜像仓库

`Chart`：访问Helm Chart
parameters.name: module_name
